name: MultiPriv
intro: MultiPriv是系统评估视觉语言模型个体级别隐私推理能力的基准，通过隐私感知与推理框架和双语多模态数据集，涵盖属性检测、跨图像重识别和链式推理等九项挑战性任务。
build_method: 公开数据筛选, 受控合成, 人工任务设计, 混合验证

task_type: 视觉问答, 隐私感知, 个体级隐私推理
eval_feature: PPR, 九项任务, 身份关联, 双语分层风险指标
scale: 1,119 张图像, 7,414 条人工 VQA, 40 个合成个体
task_type_en: Visual QA, Privacy Perception, Individual-level Privacy Reasoning
build_method_en: Public-data Curation, Controlled Synthesis, Manual Task Design, Hybrid Verification
eval_feature_en: PPR Framework, Nine Tasks, Identity Linkage, Bilingual Hierarchical Risk Metrics
intro_en: MultiPriv is a benchmark for systematically evaluating the individual-level privacy inference capabilities of vision-language models. It features a privacy-aware inference framework and a bilingual multimodal dataset, covering nine challenging tasks including attribute detection, cross-image re-identification, and chain reasoning.

drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2511.16940v3 Sections 3.3-3.5 and Appendices B, D, E, and H, plus the official CyberChangAn/MultiPriv-PII repository. The diagram reflects 36 fine-grained attributes in seven categories, 40 fully synthetic profiles, 1,119 images, and 7,414 manually designed bilingual VQA pairs. It separates four perception tasks from five reasoning tasks, records the three-step individual synthesis pipeline and the approximately 18 percent Doubao-generated attribute pool, and preserves the 93 percent deterministic plus 7 percent Qwen2.5-72B-and-human verification split. Refusals are reported as privacy mitigation rather than counted as successful privacy extraction.
